description: `--findRelatedTests src/changed.ts --coverage` with `collectCoverageFrom: ['src/**/*.ts']`: in Jest 30.5.2 `SearchResult.collectCoverageFrom` (SearchSource.ts L196-L231) is built and never read by `runJest`, so this golden shows whether coverage is restricted to the related files at all.
